lines: Hey, just once more.
Let's do it countless times, let's make that our destiny.
I failed to convey my love.
But I was surely in love.
I was in love.
A toast with canned coffee.
The sheets are damp; we are a pair beyond repair.
Because I'll do as you say.
Just pretend to be lovers, that's enough.
I want you to smile, at least for now.
Realizing the unnecessary baggage
is the hill we’re exhausted from climbing.
Since when is it okay to forget
When does the desire to forget end?
Hey, just once more.
Let's keep doing it over and over, let's remain that destiny.
I failed to convey my love.
But I was certainly in love.
I was in love.
Rely on pointless talk.
To carry the hidden, weary sins.
Even though it's you who may be forgotten.
Am I the only one who wants to forget?
Hey, just once more.
Shall we just cancel it? Let's seize that destiny.
I missed the chance to convey my love.
I want to fall into a love like this again.
I want to fall in love.
Nakedness, stroked shoulders, kisses, hair that won't dry.
If I could be with you once more.
Surely, even more properly
I'll properly convey my love.
Because I will never lose you again.
Discard words, give up little by little.
Hold tightly to this overly fragile today, then let it go.
I'm home, goodbye.
Just now, goodbye.
